content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after a visible error appears on the Ir Swap form while the Counterparty field is being filled (error events 62:a64 and 50:a51/54:a56), users open Trades > Static Data and reach the Counterparty screen (navigation app:13 / app:30), then return to Ir Swap through the Trades tab (app:15 / app:32), which suggests the Counterparty value is not available inline on the Ir Swap form.", "fix": "Fix: On the Ir Swap screen, Counterparty input, add an inline counterparty search or picker that lists valid counterparties so users can select one without leaving for Trades > Static Data, and render the visible validation error next to the field that raised it with its field label.", "cited_event_ids": ["62:a64", "67", "68", "101", "app:13", "123", "app:15", "50:a51", "54:a56", "77", "78", "112", "app:30", "134", "app:32"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The error text and the field it refers to are not in the events; the error in session S8c531a3d follows Counterparty focus, but in S863594b4 the errors follow Trade Date input, so the field responsible is not established.", "The reason users navigate to Static Data is not in the events; the link to a missing inline counterparty lookup is inferred from the sequence.", "Whether the Counterparty screen actually contains the needed data is not shown.", "The return path depends on app_action success events, whose content is not visible.", "Dropped pointer samples (123 and 134) may hide some hover or scroll behaviour."]}
